representative_scale.selection: All PINDER-S test cases with paired apo receptor and ligand structures. Freeze exact IDs before execution.
representative_scale.candidate_count_reason: Brief requires a fixed candidate count but specifies none; no published value established. Intake does not fabricate one.
representative_scale.repeat_count_reason: Independent seeds requested; numeric schedule unavailable.

inputs.required: Paired apo structures, experimental native dimer, index and residue/chain mappings for each selected case.
inputs.generated_candidate_inputs: Original apo monomers for realistic docking; do not use native complex to initialize a pose. AAV components are separated bound structures, evaluated separately.

outputs.candidate_poses: Per-case ranked two-chain PDB models in eval_dir/method/PINDER_ID/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb, chains R and L.

scoring_interface.aav_interface: BiotiteDockQ with explicit receptor/ligand chain mappings after assembly extraction; not automatically PINDER IDs.

outputs.aggregate_reason: No published aggregate acceptance criterion established.

timing_scope.primary: Start after required inputs are staged; include monomer preparation, docking search, scoring/ranking and pose serialization. Record evaluation-harness time separately.
timing_scope.setup: Report input download, install/build and initialization separately.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable_pose: Elapsed search time when acceptable candidate is generated; requires generation timestamps. Offline best-of-N evaluation alone cannot establish it.
timing_scope.fair_comparison: Fix cases and candidate budget; report search coverage separately from ranking quality; compare wall time, cost and CPU/GPU allocation.

unavailable_reasons: Upstream docking archive, intended-use permissions and pin unresolved.
Exact case manifest, candidate count and independent seed schedule not established.
Published runner needs validation; no new command invented.
Peak memory and full 93-case runtime unmeasured; cannot assert completion within default budgets.
AAV assembly and chain/domain selection unresolved.
budget_policy: One fixed 93-case scale; no doubling or scale search. No stage scripts created or run during intake. If representative run cannot fit stage budgets, report unsupported rather than extrapolate from toy cases.
gate_scripts_reason: Prompt names no filesystem gate scripts. JSON and anchor structural validation performed locally.
